details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 9 - The Veterans · Seat 1, Front line

A grey-skinned Jotunas goliath woman, her stone-pale markings running down her arms, her black hair in long braids, with a rune-cut great axe and snowshoes slung on her back. Loud, warm and blunt, she treats every fight as a contest she fully intends to win. The Keepers pulled her raiding band out of a goblin warren, and she pays that debt in blood and laughter.

In a fight

Hit a foe before it acts to knock it Prone (Ambush Strike), rage on the first swing in Reckless or Brutal style, and Whirlwind when three crowd you. Use Terrifying to Frighten a whole pack at once. When the troll drops, oil the axe with fire or throw a flask before it gets up.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Rage. As part of an attack or your move, rage for the rest of the encounter, 4 times a day. While raging, +2 melee weapon damage. It ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

Rage Styles. Each time you rage, choose one style for that rage (improved from 8th). Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but only the first attack against you each round has Advantage. Brutal: once a round when you hit, the target makes a Fortitude save (DC 17) or is shoved 10ft and knocked Prone. Terrifying: once per rage, as part of an attack, Intimidate every creature of your choice within 15ft (each saves separately; Level 9 or lower).

Whirlwind Attack. Once per rage, while raging, replace your action: one attack roll against each of up to 3 opponents within 5ft whose Level is 4 or lower. You cannot have retreated first.

Extra Attack. When you use your action to attack, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage. Advantage from any source never cancels it.

Intimidate (Strength). Uses your action. One creature of Level 9 or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 17) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. No daily limit.

Primeval Will. Once a day, when you drop to 18 HP or less, gain 18 bonus HP, lost first and gone when combat ends. If you drop to 0 or below first, it triggers by itself; at 1 HP or more after it, keep fighting. It cannot stop a blow that kills you outright.

Ancestral Calling. The first time you rage each day, allies within 30ft gain 9 temporary HP until the end of the day.

Force of Nature. +1 to saves against spells and magical effects.

Iron Sinews. Your weapon attacks count as magic.

Combat Sense. Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised. Attackers gain no Advantage on you from flanking or from being Unseen, and rear-attack bonuses such as Back Attack do not work on you.

Thick Hide. +2 AC in light armour or none (included).

Primeval Instincts. Out of medium and heavy armour, Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances. Hold your breath twice as long, and climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

Kit: Ambush Strike. Your first hit on a creature that hasn't yet acted this combat knocks it Prone (a Fortitude save negates).

Kit: Desert Born. Advantage on Survival checks in arid or desert terrain, and on checks to identify Red Waste tribal markings or customs.

Goliath (Jotunas). Large: a 10ft space, 5ft more melee reach and no Heavy weapon Disadvantage, but Disadvantage on Stealth and in tight spaces. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to cold. Advantage on Strength checks to push, drag, lift or break against something smaller. Advantage on Jotunas terrain, tribal-custom and giant-lineage checks, and on Charisma checks towards Dul Khagul dwarves.

Mountain Endurance. Once a day, when hit, reduce the damage by 1d12+3 (1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Fortitude saves against exhaustion, forced marching and thin mountain air.

Toughness (1st, General). +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

Critical Strike (2nd, Martial). Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits.

Flowing Strikes (6th, Martial). Once a round, when you hit with a melee attack, make one more melee attack: with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels against the creature you hit, a normal roll against a different one in reach. It can't trigger itself.

HP. 1st level: d12 max 12 + Con 3 = 15. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (7 + 3) = 80. Toughness: 9. Total 104.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 4 (Studded Leather +1) + 1 (Dex) + 2 (Thick Hide, light armour) = 17

Class Abilities

1st Level

Combat Sense

  • Effect: Heightened battlefield awareness that makes the Barbarian difficult to catch off guard.
  • Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised
  • Attackers gain no Advantage from flanking against you
  • A creature that is Unseen or behind you gains no Advantage against you unless it is Hidden

Rage

  • Effect: As part of an attack or your movement, enter a rage that lasts for the encounter, usable 1 + Constitution modifier times per day (minimum 2/day).
  • While raging, gain a flat bonus to melee weapon damage: +2 (1st-9th level), +4 (10th-19th level), +6 (20th+).
  • Rage ends early if a full round passes without the Barbarian attacking or taking damage.

Intimidate (Strength)

  • Effect: Uses your action. One creature of equal or lower Level within 15ft makes a Will save (against your Class Save DC) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
  • No daily limit

Primeval Instincts

  • Effect: When not wearing medium or heavy armour, have Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks when failing the check would cost you HP, Exhaustion or your life (see Fatigue & Exhaustion in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Hold your breath twice as long as normal
  • Survive extreme temperatures and weather 1 day longer than normal
  • Advantage on Fortitude saves made to force march
  • Find shelter, food, and water for themselves automatically in any wilderness environment (1d6+2 hours)
  • Start a fire in 1d10 minutes by natural means
  • Determine true north at will
  • Climb typical natural slopes and swim typical rivers without a check — half speed, in light armour or none
  • Cannot use the shelter, fire, navigation and climbing abilities above while wearing medium or heavy armour

Thick Hide

  • Effect: While wearing no armour or light armour, gain +2 AC (+3 from 10th level). It does not stack with other bonuses of the same kind.

2nd Level

Rage Styles

  • Effect: Each time you enter a rage, choose one style. It lasts for that rage.
  • Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you by a creature you attacked this turn have Advantage. 8th level: only its first attack against you each round has Advantage
  • Brutal: once per round, when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone, your choice, never both (Fortitude save against your Class Save DC). 8th level: you may use Brutal on two hits each round, choosing shove or Prone for each
  • Terrifying: once per rage, use Intimidate as part of an attack instead of your action. 8th level: once per rage, as part of an attack, Intimidate every creature of your choice within 15ft (each saves separately; Intimidate's Level limit applies)
  • 8th level: your styles improve, as listed under each one.

3rd Level

Iron Sinews

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks count as magic, so they can harm creatures that only magic weapons can hurt.
  • 7th level: your weapon attacks also deal +1 damage, on top of any magic weapon's bonus (a +1 axe hits for +2)
  • 13th level: +2 damage, and your weapon attacks ignore Resistance to slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage

4th Level

Primeval Will

  • Effect: Once per day, when you drop to half your HP or less, you gain temporary HP equal to twice your Barbarian level until the encounter ends. If a blow would drop you to 0 HP, it triggers first.

5th Level

Savage Swing

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage while you are Raging.
  • If both attacks hit one creature no more than one size larger than you, on its next turn it can move or act, not both.

Cleaving Fury

  • Effect: While raging, once per round when you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the blow carries through: another enemy within your reach takes damage equal to your weapon's damage dice, with no attack roll. Your Cleave on a kill works as normal on top.
  • 13th level: add your Rage bonus to that damage

6th Level

Force of Nature

  • Effect: While raging, you have Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. Magic from the primeval world bends around the Barbarian's raw will.
  • 16th level: at all times, not only while raging

7th Level

Savage Stride

  • Effect: While raging, your speed increases by 10ft, difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and you may Jump as part of your move with Advantage.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: permanent +1 Strength

20th Level

Renown: War-camp

  • Effect: You may found a war-camp (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 warriors join it, with one 3rd-level Barbarian to lead every 20. While you hold it, once per season you may call the host: where your name and deeds are known, 10 to 100 1st-level Barbarians answer and fight for 30 days for food and water alone (the GM sets how many a land can raise).
  • The host has AC 13 and fights with sword or axe. Failed campaigns shrink it until your name is restored

24th Level

World Ender

  • Effect: Your mastery of combat reaches a mythic threshold: nothing within reach is safe, and nothing without magic stops you.
  • Cleaving Fury carries through to every enemy within 10ft of you, not just one

Kits: Arneyan Warrior Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Barbarian folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the warrior culture that shaped you.

(Constitution) Gain +1 Max HP per level (retroactive). Gain +1 to Constitution (once, on taking this feat). Advantage on Constitution-based checks.

Open to all classes by default.

You are a master of precision. Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

Once per round, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, let the momentum carry through — make one extra melee attack.

  • Against the creature you just hit it is rolled with Disadvantage; against a different creature within your reach it is a normal roll.
  • The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
